name: The Rope Bridge
intro: A frayed rope bridge spans a black chasm. On the far side, goblins crouch behind crates around a smoking brazier, and the planks at their end of the bridge glisten with spilled lamp oil.
dmNotes: Bugbear Grall (hidden, K2) waits until a PC steps onto the bridge, then charges with advantage. Goblins will try to cut the bridge ropes if two or more PCs are on it (DC 12 ruling, 2 goblin actions). The brazier at F4 can be toppled into the oil at G4-H4: oil ignites, bridge planks catch next round. Goblins flee once Grall drops or 2 goblins are down.

rook.name: Rook
rook.notes: Human Fighter 3 (Champion: crits on 19-20). Second Wind: bonus action, heal 1d10+3. Action Surge: one extra action.

wren.name: Wren
wren.notes: Halfling Rogue 3. Sneak Attack +2d6 once per turn with advantage or an ally adjacent to the target (use --extra 2d6). Cunning Action: bonus-action Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
wren.persona: Wiry, sardonic, allergic to fair fights. Prefers high ground, flanks, and anything involving fire. Will loot mid-combat if she thinks nobody's looking.

ash.name: Brother Ash
ash.notes: Dwarf Life Cleric 3. Sacred Flame (cantrip): target in 60 ft makes DC 13 DEX save or takes 1d8 radiant (use: damage <id> 1d8 radiant --save dex --dc 13). Spells: Bless, Cure Wounds, Healing Word, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon (2nd, bonus action), Hold Person (2nd, DC 13 WIS). Life domain: healing spells add 2 + spell level.
ash.persona: Gravelly, patient, deeply suspicious of bridges. Keeps everyone alive first, smites second. Quotes scripture nobody else has heard of.

gob1.name: Goblin Cutter
gob1.notes: Nimble Escape: bonus-action Disengage or Hide. Has a knife for the bridge ropes.

gob2.name: Goblin Archer
gob2.notes: Nimble Escape. Stays behind the crates.

gob3.name: Goblin Archer
gob3.notes: Nimble Escape. Uses the rubble for cover.

grall.name: Grall the Bugbear
grall.notes: Surprise Attack: +2d6 on a hit against a surprised creature (use --extra 2d6). Brute. Bosses the goblins around; they rout if he falls.
